definitions.gloss: to conclude, to wrap up, to bring to a close
definitions.explanation: To bring something to a fitting conclusion. Used for speeches, events, projects, or any activity that needs a proper ending.

examples.japanese: ⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{締|し}め{括|くく}る。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{締|し}め{括|くく}りたい。
examples.english: I want to wrap up this year on a good note.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{締|し}め{括|くく}った。
examples.english: He concluded with words of gratitude.

notes:
{締|し}め{括|くく}る means to bring something to a fitting conclusion or wrap-up. It implies a deliberate, satisfying ending rather than simply stopping.
